evidence.level: retained-edge recalculation plus available public reference bytes
evidence.limitation: Same retained graphs and per-file seed; no fresh FCI fit or native pipeline run.

evidence.level: reaggregation of retained per-scenario scores; heterogeneous tally readback
evidence.limitation: Does not rerun model queries or re-score every native response. Historical Causal-Copilot stage/cohort/scorer differs; no common-condition ranking.

findings.limitation: The committed diagnostic is not the original intermediate-state archive. Public source ZIP lacks full stage states and model-call records.

findings.status: retained-cell summary producer rerun; raw intervention evaluation remains open

evidence.level: original summary producer rerun from retained per-cell JSON; not an independent evaluator
evidence.limitation: The retained-cell merge checks reported aggregates, controls and predictions. It does not recompute interventions or revalidate the statistical evaluator from raw expression arrays.

findings.limitation: A recorded within-tolerance flag is not a fresh reproduction. Raw filtered intervention arrays and evaluator environment are separate inputs.

findings.status: frozen counts and historical endpoint discrepancy retained
findings.limitation: No confirmatory endpoint claim; specified pre-cycle and computed final-output endpoints differ. No protocol amendment.

findings.status: frozen point and interval interpretation retained; no fresh native rerun
findings.limitation: Point below its data-only graph does not establish interval exclusion. See frozen MATMCD diagnostic report.
Reference identity and documented provenance do not independently establish ground truth; no fresh licence/legal determination.

findings.status: prior scoped reviews retained; current exact native coverage separate
findings.limitation: Inventory and source identity are not a new full-text corpus review or independent scientific validation of S1-S4.

correlation: Single audit implementation; independent formula for retained FCI edges, not an independent reviewer or new experiment.
